summary: Pampa Energy Inc. filed a Form 6-K with its Q1 2026 earnings release. The filing reports quarterly financial results: sales of US$573 million (up 38% YoY), adjusted EBITDA of US$325 million (up 48% YoY), net income of US$214 million (up 40% YoY), and net debt of US$1.2 billion. It describes operational drivers such as higher shale oil production and power generation margins but contains no transaction, board recommendation, or structural event. This is a routine earnings report and does not constitute a special-situation corporate action.
